configurePresets.name: ci
configurePresets.description: Hosted-CI configure: same as default but targets the Visual Studio 2022 toolset on the GitHub windows-2022 runner (which has no VS 2026).

configurePresets.name: clangd
configurePresets.description: Tooling-only config that emits compile_commands.json for clangd-based editors (Zed, VS Code, neovim). The Visual Studio generator cannot export a compile database, so this uses Ninja into a separate build/clangd/ dir. Run from a VS Developer prompt (cl + ninja on PATH) with VCPKG_ROOT pointing at your own vcpkg (a VS dev prompt may override it to the bundled copy): cmake --preset=clangd. The .clangd file points clangd at build/clangd/. Do NOT build from here; build with --preset=default.
